help.tagline: Zero-intrusion native multi-account wrapper for official agy
help.cmd.default: Launch native agy (direct to Google, auto-failover & resume on 5h/7d limit)
help.cmd.ui: Interactive dashboard (Tab: Pool / Open Sessions / Token Usage)
help.cmd.status: Dual-pool status board (-r live refresh, --active active only, --reset clear cooldown, --mask)
help.cmd.resume: Interactive session picker (CWD/All + live search; or pass conversation ID)
help.cmd.next: Switch to next available account; with flags, launch agy immediately
help.cmd.use: Select active account; with flags, launch agy immediately
help.cmd.auth: Manage credentials: login, import token file/dir, or remove account
help.cmd.config: Configure reserve (0-50), auto-compact (90%/off), notify (on/off), seamless (on/off), lang (auto/en/zh)
help.cmd.doctor: Environment isolation, schema contract, and account pool diagnostics
help.opt.account: Use a specific account for this run
help.opt.title: Custom terminal tab title (auto-syncs with /rename and session title)
help.opt.reserve: Override low-quota proactive switch threshold for this run
help.opt.refresh: Refresh active account quota before launching
help.opt.no_seamless: Disable seamless in-place hot-swap and use zero-proxy --resume failover instead
help.opt.passthrough: POSIX explicit passthrough of all remaining flags to native agy
help.ex.resume: Browse CWD / all sessions interactively with live search (Ctrl+N switches account)
help.ex.next: Switch to the next ready account and launch agy with native flags

config.desc.reserve: (proactively switch before launch when active remaining <= threshold; 0 = drain to 0%)
config.desc.compact: (passed to child agy via env; never modifies dotfiles unless --sync-shell is passed)
config.desc.notify: (desktop notification when turn >=30s completes or on 429 failover; silent on headless SSH)
config.desc.seamless: (zero-interruption mid-turn 429 hot-swap via ephemeral local CA on Linux/macOS; direct fallback on Windows)
config.desc.lang: (UI/CLI language: auto follows system locale, or explicit en / zh)
config.err.reserve: reserve must be a number between 0 and 50 (e.g. agy-pro config reserve 10)
config.ok.compact_synced_hint: (open a new shell or source it for bare agy)
config.err.notify: notify accepts only on or off (e.g. agy-pro config notify off)
config.err.seamless: seamless accepts only on or off (e.g. agy-pro config seamless off)
config.usage: Usage: agy-pro config [reserve <0-50> | auto-compact <90%|800K|700000|off> [--sync-shell] | notify <on|off> | seamless <on|off> | lang <auto|en|zh>]
auth.usage.title: Usage: agy-pro auth <login | import [path] | rm <keyword|email>>
auth.usage.login: login           Sign in a new account via official agy acp --login
auth.usage.import: import [path]   Import token file/dir (omit path to import current active agy token)
auth.usage.rm: rm <keyword>    Remove an account from the pool
auth.err.unknown: unknown auth subcommand: %s (expected login / import / rm)
auth.login.start: Launching official %s to sign in a new Google account
auth.login.ok: Signed in and saved to isolated pool: %s
auth.import.no_active: No active file token found at %s. Pass a file/dir path or run %s.
auth.import.none_found: No valid antigravity-oauth-token files found under %s.
next.usage:
Usage: agy-pro next [native agy flags...]
  Without flags: switches to the next available account.
  With flags: switches account and launches native agy immediately (e.g. agy-pro next --dangerously-skip-permissions).
resume.usage.2: Without ID: opens interactive session picker (CWD/All via Tab, live search, Enter current acct, Ctrl+N next acct).
resume.usage.3: With ID: resumes that conversation directly and forwards remaining native agy flags.
run.no_last_conv: agy-pro · no recent session for current dir, starting new session
run.kind.fast: hit 429 quota wall (fast switch, verifying reset in background)
run.failover_no_conv: No persisted local session file found to safely resume. Switched active account; run %s to pick your conversation.
run.seamless_windows_unsupported: --seamless mode is currently supported on Linux/macOS only; falling back to standard zero-proxy failover
run.seamless_start_err: failed to start seamless proxy (%v); falling back to standard zero-proxy failover
